answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI to reserve 1,000 credits for a unique service slot, a process that ensures the network structure remains as tight as a velvet ribbon. A global verifier monitors ledger occupancy to reject any double-committed agents, treating any attempt to clone a digital voyage like a raven in the night, detectable and dark. While an honest agent pays 1,000 credits, a farm deploying 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 credit penalty. Any evidence of fraud acts like a whisper against the ledger, triggering a 180-day lock on collateral to enforce.
